verdict.rationale: Jules' docs say it needs access to your repositories, and it works directly with GitHub: you assign tasks with a "jules" label on an issue, and it opens PRs. One community user praises its "good github integrations." None of the evidence describes how access is granted or shows that it is a one-click install with minimal setup. Missing for 10: documented one-click install or connection flow (e.g., an app install or OAuth step), evidence of minimal setup steps, per-repo access scoping, and hands-on corroboration of how easy onboarding is.

support.subject: As a developer, I can grant an agent access to my repositories with a one-click install, without complex setup

citations.quote: Jules needs access to your repositories in order to work.
Use the "jules" label in an issue to assign a task directly in GitHub.
